findings: Identidad/version: こそ; SHA-256 de articleMarkdown 57d02be22eb02b3b16f42428e1339ae2f084d22e9e923b4cf6c2fffb79ae9637; la fila wiki_articles y generatedAt 2026-09-19T09:27:44.525Z coinciden con el JSON canónico local. La coincidencia confirma identidad, no exactitud semántica.
The focus/alternative-set analysis of こそ is a formal pragmatic claim; no grammar source with exact contrastive-focus locator was obtained.
こちらこそ and 今度こそ are idiomatic readings but need dictionary/usage evidence; translating 君 as vos is regional Spanish editorial choice.
The contrasts with だけ and さえ require a source that compares scalar/focus functions, not separate glossary definitions.
The example set and claims about implicit alternatives have not been checked in corpus or academic semantics.
